reference.quote: 按照有关规定经过有驾驶人智能网联汽车道路测试并达到规定里程或者时间，且未发生交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。
reference.value: mileage or time of with-driver road testing >= prescribed value; manual takeover rate within prescribed value (set by other rules); eligibility for driverless road-test confirmation

reference.quote: 开展高风险道路测试的，应当经过规定里程或者时间的低风险道路测试，且未发生严重交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。
reference.value: low-risk road testing mileage or time >= prescribed value; takeover rate within prescribed value (set by other rules); eligibility for high-risk road testing

reference.quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当经过规定里程或者时间的道路测试，且未发生交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。
reference.value: road-testing mileage or time >= prescribed value; takeover rate within prescribed value (set by other rules); eligibility for demonstration application

reference.quote: 经过规定里程或者时间的示范应用，且未发生交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值。
reference.value: demonstration-application mileage or time >= prescribed value; takeover rate within prescribed value (set by other rules); eligibility for demonstration operation

reference.quote: 开展无驾驶人智能网联汽车道路测试、示范应用、示范运营达到规定里程或者时间，且未发生交通违法行为以及因车辆原因造成的安全事故，人工接管率符合规定值的，企业可以向浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会提出同一阶段同一型号车辆批量申请确认
reference.value: mileage or time >= prescribed value; takeover rate within prescribed value (set by other rules); eligibility for batch confirmation of same-model vehicles

reference.quote: 发生三次以上一般道路交通违法行为
reference.value: >= 3 general road traffic violations (vehicle): suspension of the vehicle or same-model vehicles

reference.quote: 发生三次以上不按照交通信号指示通行、违反标志标线指示、逆向行驶等严重道路交通违法行为的
reference.value: >= 3 serious road traffic violations (vehicle): termination of the vehicle or same-model vehicles

reference.quote: 2022年11月23日上海市第十五届人民代表大会常务委员会第四十六次会议通过
reference.value: 2022-11-23 adopted by the Standing Committee of the 15th Shanghai Municipal People's Congress

reference.quote: 本规定自2023年2月1日起施行。
由浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会暂停有关企业的相关创新应用活动，责令其限期整改；完成整改后，方可恢复相关创新应用活动
reference.value: suspension of the enterprise's innovation activities and order to rectify within a time limit (10 listed grounds); no monetary amount

reference.quote: 由浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会暂停该车辆或者同型号车辆的相关创新应用活动，责令其限期整改
reference.value: suspension of the vehicle or same-model vehicles and order to rectify (3 listed grounds); no monetary amount

reference.quote: 由浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会终止有关企业的相关创新应用活动，相关号牌、标牌和营运证件失效
reference.value: termination of the enterprise's activities; plates, signs and operating permits become invalid; no monetary amount

reference.quote: 由浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会终止该车辆或者同型号车辆的相关创新应用活动；情节严重的，终止有关企业的相关创新应用活动
reference.value: termination of the vehicle or same-model vehicles; enterprise termination if serious; no monetary amount

reference.quote: 安全性自我声明未经确认或者未取得临时行驶车号牌、相关车辆营运证件擅自开展相关活动的，由浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会责令立即终止相关活动，并由有关主管部门依法进行处理。
reference.value: order to stop unauthorised activities immediately, plus handling under other laws (penalty by reference)

reference.quote: 由公安机关按照道路交通安全法律、法规对车辆所有人或者管理人进行处理
reference.value: traffic violations handled by public security against the vehicle owner or manager under road traffic safety laws (penalty by reference)
